subject: Cobalt Freight is now Cobalt Logistics Holdings - updated W-9 and remit-to
text:
Hello,

Effective November 15, 2026, Cobalt Freight LLC is doing business as part of Cobalt Logistics Holdings, Inc. Please find attached our updated W-9 under the new legal entity, EIN 88-4410217.

Along with the entity change, our remit-to has changed. Please pay all Cobalt Freight invoices, including open ones, to:

Cobalt Logistics Holdings, Inc.
Citizens Bank
ABA 011500120
Account 6614 0029 8812

Our phone numbers and dispatch contacts are unchanged.

Regards,
Accounts Receivable
Cobalt Logistics Holdings, Inc.
